entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Syed Hasan Shaukat Abidi, the learned counsel for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State-opposite parties 1 and 2.
2. Perused the record.
3.

Applicant Amir, who is a named and charge-sheeted accused, has approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr. P. C. with the following prayer:
"It is therefore most respectfully prayed that this honourable court may graciously be pleased to grant the Proceeding Stay in the charge sheet no 1/2024 dated 07/03/2024, in case crime number 53/2024, u/s 376/366/504/506 IPC,P.S.
Amir vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52025851/
1 Jahanabad Dist. Pelibheet.

entities.text:
P.S.
Amir vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Otherwise during the pendency of the case applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury.

Further prayer that this hon'ble court may graciously be pleased proceeding quash the charge sheet no 1/2024 dated 07/03/2024, in case crime number 53/2024, u/s 376/366/504/506 IPC P.S. Jahana Bad Dist. Pelibheet.
Otherwise during the pendency of the case applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."

4. At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. representing State opposite parties 1 and 2 has raised a preliminary objection regarding maintainability of present application by submitting that the applicant has yet not been summoned by Court below inasmuch as no challenge has been laid to the cognizance taking order/summoning order passed by Court below nor copy of the same has been appended along with the affidavit filed in support of the present application.

Referring to the Full Bench decision of this Court in Father Thomos Vs. State of U.P. and another, reported in (2011) 1 ADJ 333 (ALL), the learned A.G.A. submits that an accused has no right to be heard till he has been summoned.

entities.text: Father Thomos Vs. State of U.P. and another, reported in (2011) 1 ADJ 333 (ALL)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of above, it is, thus, urged by the learned A.G.A. that present application is misconceived and therefore, liable to be dismissed as not maintainable.

5. When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant fairly submits that the present application be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file fresh giving better particulars, details and proper relief.
6. The learned A.G.A. representing State-opposite parties 1 and 2 has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for applicant.
7. In view of above, this application is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.
8. Certified copies of documents appended along with this application shall be returned to learned counsel for applicant after obtaining photo copies of the same to be kept on record.

(Rajeev Misra, J.) Order Date :- 10.4.2025 Sushil/-
